title: xAI burned $6.4B last year — SpaceX’s IPO filing shows why the spending is far from over
brief: xAI, Elon Musk's AI company, burned $6.4 billion in 2025 according to SpaceX's IPO filing, the first public disclosure of the company's financials. The losses reflect aggressive expansion of the Grok LLM and infrastructure investments that are expected to continue.
